annotation.title_clean: Komisia uverejňuje usmernenia k vymedzeniu systému umelej inteligencie s cieľom uľahčiť uplatňovanie pravidiel prvého aktu o umelej inteligencii
annotation.title_en: The Commission publishes guidelines on AI system definition to facilitate the first AI Act's rules application
named_instruments_referenced: Guidelines on prohibited AI practices (AI Act)
annotation.summary_en: European Commission news item (Slovak version) announcing non-binding guidelines on the AI system definition under the EU AI Act. The guidelines help providers determine whether software counts as an AI system. They were published alongside the guidelines on prohibited practices, after the Act's first rules started to apply on 2 February 2025. The page links to the guidelines in all EU languages.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines help providers determine whether a software system is an AI system under the AI Act
Guidelines are non-binding and will be updated as practical experience grows
Published alongside the guidelines on prohibited AI practices
AI Act classifies systems into prohibited, high-risk and transparency-obligation categories
First AI Act rules (definition, AI literacy, prohibitions) have applied since 2 February 2025
